brief.title: Draft referral options from the public services directory
brief.plain_summary: Filter the public services directory with the read-only tool by the service needs an advocate entered, and list matching options with each entry's last verified date.
brief.outcome: Referral options for the advocate, with entries not verified in 90 days marked verify first.

service_needs.description: Pin of a noun holding only the service types, languages, hours and access needs the advocate entered: no story, name, contact details or location.

directory.description: Pin of a noun holding the public services directory, as published.

verify_after_days.description: Entries not verified within this many days are marked verify first.
